title: De-duplicate reverse-reference computation
description:
## G-2 (from kb-graph-rag-audit)

Two independent implementations of "what points to this record" exist: a single-ID method (GetReverseReferencesAsync, used by MemoryViewer.razor's "Incoming References" panel) and a batch inline builder (used only inside context-pack assembly in MemoryApplicationService.cs). Consolidate into one.

### Detailed Steps
1. Extract a single `GetReverseReferencesAsync(IReadOnlyCollection<string> ids)` batch-capable method backed by the G-1 index
2. Have the single-ID workbench call site pass a one-element collection
3. Delete the inline `reverseRefMap` construction in the context-pack path in favor of this method

### Test Plan
- Existing context-pack tests and MemoryViewer tests continue to pass unmodified
